name: Casa de ardósia · Interior
prompt:
Create ONE SQUARE furnished cottage interior as a STRICT 2D ARCHITECTURAL FLOOR PLAN. Identity and furnishing: a tidy rural cottage with overlapping grey slate roof tiles; interior dark wooden floor, brass lamp, table and bed.. CRITICAL CAMERA: TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC NADIR, straight DOWN from a camera directly vertically ABOVE, 90 degrees to the ground, like an architectural plan. There is ZERO camera tilt and ZERO perspective convergence. Show ONLY upward-facing surfaces. Never show the front, vertical side, upright facade, drawer fronts, tall backrest face, front legs or any elevation. All straight opposite edges remain perfectly parallel. Round tops are CIRCLES, never ellipses. This is a battlemap sprite, not an isometric or catalog product view. Four perimeter walls appear ONLY as equal-width horizontal TOP CUT surfaces; no visible upright wall faces. Corner beams are small square end-grain TOPS. Floor is a rectangle with perfectly parallel edges. Every furniture item is a flat TOP silhouette, including ONLY plain cabinet TOPS: absolutely no drawers, handles, vertical cabinet fronts, chair backs, bed legs or vertical furniture faces. Room is about 6 by 6 five-foot cells, a bed is two cells long and a chair smaller than one. Keep a clear walking route through the middle. The ONLY doorway is a clean OPEN GAP in the BOTTOM wall, centered 48.6% across the complete room outline and 14.4% of room width. Do not draw a door leaf or panel. Windows are ONLY thin blue-grey glass TOP slivers inside these exact walls: top wall at 21.8% of its length, top wall at 78.2% of its length, bottom wall at 23.2% of its length, bottom wall at 76.8% of its length, left wall at 50.0% of its length, right wall at 50.0% of its length. No other windows. Complete square room centered on transparent alpha, no roof, exterior grass, stairs, floor disk, labels, grid, text or watermark. Realistic detailed hand-painted medieval materials and soft even overhead light.
Strict plan projection for tall furniture: cupboards and bookcases show ONLY opaque horizontal top boards, NEVER their doors or book-spine faces. Fireplaces and forges show ONLY a U-shaped top-cut stone rim around an open coal pit, NEVER a front firebox opening or facade. Vertical posts appear ONLY as circular end-grain caps, with shafts occluded beneath them.
